description: This is a C++ source file implementing the 'XCast' plugin for a multimedia casting service. It manages application launch, hide, resume, stop requests, and registration of applications for casting. It includes configuration, event handling, timer-based retries, and inter-process communication with a remote service via JSON RPC and IARM (Inter-Application Resource Manager). The code controls enabling/disabling cast functionality, responds to system power events, and handles friend name updates.

classes.name: XCast
classes.description: Main plugin class managing casting functionalities, application control, configuration, and event handling.

methods.name: getUrlFromAppLaunchParams
methods.description: Constructs a URL for launching applications based on provided app name, payload, query, and additional data URL.

methods.name: getEntryFromAppLaunchParamList
methods.description: Fetches launch parameters for a given app name from internal cache.

methods.name: dumpDynamicAppConfigCache
methods.description: Logs the details of dynamic application configuration cache.

methods.name: deleteFromDynamicAppCache
methods.description: Removes specified application entries from dynamic cache.

methods.name: updateDynamicAppCache
methods.description: Updates internal cache with new application configurations received.

methods.name: checkRFCServiceStatus
methods.description: Checks system configuration via RFC to determine if cast feature is enabled.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up IARM, services, and timers.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, stops timers, and de-initializes systems.

methods.name: powerModeChange
methods.description: Handles power state change events from system IARM bus.

methods.name: onLocateCastTimer
methods.description: Timer callback to attempt reconnection and re-registration of applications.

methods.name: onRtServiceDisconnected
methods.description: Handles remote service disconnection and triggers reconnection timer.

methods.name: onFriendlyNameUpdateHandler
methods.description: Handles updates to the friendly name via event signals.

methods.name: threadPowerModeChangeEvent
methods.description: Thread function to switch cast service based on power and standby states.
